newsitem.title: USA: Beckley to merge with Horizon.
newsitem.headline: Beckley to merge with Horizon.

text.p: Horizon Bancorp Inc said Monday it has signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Beckley Bancorp Inc for $25.64, per share, cash. The total value of the transaction is about $16.9 million.
The merger said the bank will be accounted for as a purchase transaction.

The transaction, said the bank, is subject to approval by the appropriate regulatory authorities and the stockholders of Horizon and Beckley. The merger is expected to close, said the bank, during the third quarter of 1997.
Horizon operates five banks with 21 offices in West Virginia and at March 31, had consolidated assets of $942.8 million.
Beckley operates one bank with two offices located in Beckley, Raleigh County, West Virginia.
It reported total assets of $44.6 million on March 31.
